bear_assumptions: About AUD650 million normalized EBITDA at 5x plus simple net cash and AUD0.25 per share development optionality; lithium pricing normalizes sharply, production stays near the low end and growth projects earn weak returns.
base_assumptions: About AUD1.4 billion normalized EBITDA at 6x plus simple net cash and AUD0.65 per share development optionality; midpoint FY2027 volume and cost are sustained while pricing settles below the recent favorable run-rate.
bull_assumptions: About AUD2.2 billion normalized EBITDA at 7x plus simple net cash and AUD1.50 per share development optionality; firm lithium pricing, upper-end volume, P2000 and Colina execution and disciplined supply support durable margins.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger normalized owner cash flow clears base, expected, payoff and margin-of-safety gates after a canonical lithium relationship is accepted; downgrade operating quality if realized pricing, FY2027 delivery, project economics or balance-sheet discipline deteriorates.
